description: Implementation of the CBB (Crypto Byte Builder) API for buffer management and ASN.1 encoding in OpenSSL's BoringSSL project.

classes.name: CBB
classes.description: Buffer builder structure for constructing byte sequences, supporting ASN.1 encoding.

methods.name: CBB_zero
methods.description: Zeroes out a CBB structure.

methods.name: CBB_init
methods.description: Initializes a CBB with a specified initial capacity.

methods.name: CBB_init_fixed
methods.description: Initializes a CBB with a fixed buffer.

methods.name: CBB_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up a CBB, freeing resources if owned.

methods.name: CBB_finish
methods.description: Finalizes the CBB, returning the buffer and length.

methods.name: CBB_data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the data in the CBB.

methods.name: CBB_len
methods.description: Returns the length of data in the CBB.

methods.name: CBB_add_u8_length_prefixed
methods.description: Adds a length-prefixed ASN.1 element with 1-byte length.

methods.name: CBB_add_u16_length_prefixed
methods.description: Adds a length-prefixed ASN.1 element with 2-byte length.

methods.name: CBB_add_u24_length_prefixed
methods.description: Adds a length-prefixed ASN.1 element with 3-byte length.

methods.name: CBB_add_bytes
methods.description: Adds raw bytes to the buffer.

methods.name: CBB_add_zeros
methods.description: Adds zeros to the buffer.

methods.name: CBB_add_space
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for writing.

methods.name: CBB_reserve
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for future writing.

methods.name: CBB_did_write
methods.description: Updates the buffer length after writing data.

methods.name: CBB_discard_child
methods.description: Discards a child buffer.

methods.name: CBB_add_asn1_uint64
methods.description: Adds a 64-bit unsigned integer as ASN.1 INTEGER.

methods.name: CBB_add_asn1_uint64_with_tag
methods.description: Adds a 64-bit unsigned integer with a specific ASN.1 tag.

methods.name: CBB_add_asn1_int64
methods.description: Adds a 64-bit signed integer as ASN.1 INTEGER.

methods.name: CBB_add_asn1_int64_with_tag
methods.description: Adds a 64-bit signed integer with a specific ASN.1 tag.

methods.name: CBB_add_asn1_octet_string
methods.description: Adds an octet string as ASN.1.

methods.name: CBB_add_asn1_bool
methods.description: Adds a boolean value as ASN.1.

methods.name: CBB_add_asn1_oid_from_text
methods.description: Encodes an OID from dotted decimal text.

methods.name: CBB_flush_asn1_set_of
methods.description: Sorts and encodes a set of ASN.1 elements.
